_doc: Classic Era hand-entered Shaman effects for calibration. Same tag conventions as the Forever file.

Earth's Grasp.note: Stoneclaw health / Earthbind radius: leveling utility. 2026-09-27 audit: split into Stoneclaw (stun) and Earthbind (kite) halves. PvP (2026-09-27): medium, kite: Earthbind Totem radius +20% (10 -> 12 yd) for kiting; the Stoneclaw +50% health half only taunts pets. The 30/0/21 build takes 2/2.

Elemental Warding.note: -3.3%/rank Fire/Frost/Nature damage taken. PvP (2026-09-27): low, defensive: -10% Fire/Frost/Nature damage taken. The survival term already counts it at ~30% spell damage; mages, shamans, druids, poisons and Destruction warlocks push that share higher. The 30/0/21 build's alternative filler.

Call of Thunder.note: +1/2/3/4/6% Lightning Bolt and Chain Lightning crit. Raid sim calibration (2026-09-27, wowsims/classic 7779ebb, elemental-dps): removing it costs 3.9% DPS in the simulator (scorer said 3.9% on the same scale); already within tolerance, raid effects split off unchanged (3.9%). Other modes unchanged.

Improved Fire Totems.note: Fire Nova delay and Magma threat: small. 2026-09-27 audit: leveling utility only (it counted in raid-dps and raid-heal). PvP (2026-09-27): low, burst: Fire Nova Totem goes off 2 s sooner (3 s): it lands before melee leave its radius. The Magma Totem threat half is worthless in PvP.

Eye of the Storm.note: 33%/rank chance for 6s of no pushback after being crit: leveling only. PvP (2026-09-27): high, resist: Focused Casting for 6 s after every melee or ranged crit taken: no pushback while being hit. Pushback protection, not a CC breaker. Core of the 30/0/21 build.

Elemental Devastation.note: +3%/rank melee crit for 10s after a spell crit: ~40% uptime for Enhancement.

Elemental Mastery.note: Guaranteed free crit every 3 min. Not fitted to the Classic simulator: its rotation conditions on this talent, so the removal run measures a broken rotation (raidsim/run.py flags it apl_dependent). PvP (2026-09-27): high, burst: Next Fire/Frost/Nature damage spell crits for free (3 min cooldown): a guaranteed Chain Lightning or Lightning Bolt crit with Elemental Fury. The 31/0/20 alternative to Nature's Swiftness.

Elemental Focus.note: 10% Clearcasting after any damage spell. Raid sim calibration (2026-09-27, wowsims/classic 7779ebb, elemental-dps): removing it costs 4.7% DPS in the simulator (scorer said 5.1% on the same scale); already within tolerance, raid effects split off unchanged (5.2%). Other modes unchanged.

Storm Reach.note: +3 yd/rank Lightning range: leveling. PvP (2026-09-27): medium, range: +6 yd Lightning Bolt and Chain Lightning range (36 yd): more casting before melee close in. Taken by the 30/0/21 build; casters only.

Ancestral Knowledge.note: +1%/rank maximum mana. Raid sim calibration (2026-09-27, wowsims/classic 7779ebb, enhancement-dps): removing it costs -0.1% DPS in the simulator (scorer said 1.0% on the same scale); raid values scaled x0.00 to match (0.0%). Other modes unchanged.

Shield Specialization.note: +1%/rank block, +5%/rank block value: only with a shield.

Thundering Strikes.note: +1%/rank melee crit. Raid sim calibration (2026-09-27, wowsims/classic 7779ebb, enhancement-dps): removing it costs 5.1% DPS in the simulator (scorer said 5.1% on the same scale); already within tolerance, raid effects split off unchanged (5.2%). Other modes unchanged.

Enhancing Totems.note: +7.5%/rank Strength of Earth / Grace of Air: ~+9 AP per rank for you, more for the melee group. Raid sim calibration (2026-09-27, wowsims/classic 7779ebb, enhancement-dps): removing it costs 0.0% DPS in the simulator (scorer said 0.6% on the same scale); raid values scaled x0.00 to match (0.3%). Other modes unchanged.

Two-Handed Axes and Maces.note: Unlocks two-handers: Windfury on a slow two-hander is ~+15% over a one-hander for every two-hander-tagged source. Raid sim calibration (2026-09-27, wowsims/classic 7779ebb, enhancement-dps): removing it costs 0.0% DPS in the simulator (scorer said 0.5% on the same scale); raid values scaled x0.00 to match (0.0%). Other modes unchanged.

Flurry.note: +6%/rank attack speed for 3 swings after a crit (30% at 5/5). ~66% of swings hasted at raid crit -> 4/8/12/16/20%; leveling ~35% -> 2/4/6/8/10%. Raid sim calibration (2026-09-27, wowsims/classic 7779ebb, enhancement-dps): removing it costs 22.6% DPS in the simulator (scorer said 19.1% on the same scale); already within tolerance, raid effects split off unchanged (19.8%). Other modes unchanged.

Improved Weapon Totems.note: +15%/rank Windfury Totem AP (the melee group; your own imbue overrides it) and Flametongue Totem damage. Raid sim calibration (2026-09-27, wowsims/classic 7779ebb, enhancement-dps): removing it costs 0.0% DPS in the simulator (scorer said 0.6% on the same scale); raid values scaled x0.00 to match (0.5%). Other modes unchanged. PvP (2026-09-27): zero, burst: Party Windfury and Flametongue Totems only; your own Windfury Weapon replaces the totem's effect. Nothing in a duel.

Elemental Weapons.note: Windfury Weapon +13.3%/rank (40% at 3/3), Rockbiter AP +6.7%/rank. Raid sim calibration (2026-09-27, wowsims/classic 7779ebb, enhancement-dps): removing it costs 2.7% DPS in the simulator (scorer said 3.0% on the same scale); already within tolerance, raid effects split off unchanged (3.1%). Other modes unchanged.

Weapon Mastery.note: +2%/rank damage with all weapons. Raid sim calibration (2026-09-27, wowsims/classic 7779ebb, enhancement-dps): removing it costs 9.4% DPS in the simulator (scorer said 9.6% on the same scale); already within tolerance, raid effects split off unchanged (9.9%). Other modes unchanged.

Stormstrike.note: Extra attack every 20s (+17% main-hand swings with a 3.5-speed weapon) and +20% on the next 2 Nature hits (~2 of 3 shocks per window). Raid sim calibration (2026-09-26, wowsims/classic 7779ebb, enhancement-dps): removing it costs 0.0% DPS in the simulator (scorer said 9.6% on the same scale); raid values scaled x0.05 to match (0.5%). Other modes unchanged. PvP (2026-09-27): high, burst: Enhancement: extra attack plus +20% on the next 2 Nature hits (20 s cooldown): Stormstrike -> Earth Shock (-> Lightning Bolt) is the enhancement kill combo.

Ancestral Healing.note: +25% armor on crit-healed targets: tank mitigation. PvP (2026-09-27): low, avoid: Restoration: heal crits give the target +25% armor for 15 s, less melee damage on you or a flag carrier.

Totemic Focus.note: -5%/rank totem mana. Raid sim calibration (2026-09-27, wowsims/classic 7779ebb, enhancement-dps): removing it costs -0.7% DPS in the simulator (scorer said 0.5% on the same scale); raid values scaled x0.00 to match (0.0%). Other modes unchanged.

Totemic Mastery.note: 30 yd totem radius: raid healer utility. PvP (2026-09-27): low, range: Friendly totems (Stoneskin, Healing Stream, Poison Cleansing, Mana Spring) reach 30 yd instead of 20: they keep working while you kite.

Healing Way.note: 33%/rank chance per Healing Wave to stack +6% (3 stacks) on that target: ~4/8/12% on Healing Wave.

Nature's Swiftness.note: Instant Healing Wave/Chain Lightning every 3 min. PvP (2026-09-27): high, burst: Next Nature spell instant (3 min cooldown): an unkickable Chain Lightning or Lightning Bolt kill shot, or an instant Healing Wave to survive. The 30/0/21 build is built around it.

Mana Tide Totem.note: 680 mana to the group every 5 min: ~+6% of your own mana budget plus group mana.

Restorative Totems.note: Mana Spring and Healing Stream +5%/rank. Raid sim calibration (2026-09-27, wowsims/classic 7779ebb, enhancement-dps): removing it costs 0.0% DPS in the simulator (scorer said 0.6% on the same scale); raid values scaled x0.00 to match (0.0%). Other modes unchanged.

Healing Grace.note: -5%/rank healing threat. PvP (2026-09-27): zero, defensive: Only -15% healing threat: nothing in PvP (the 30/0/21 build's filler point).

Healing Focus.note: -14%/rank pushback on heals. PvP (2026-09-27): medium, resist: 70% chance to ignore pushback on heals: healing while being hit. Core for Restoration; a better 30/0/21 filler than Healing Grace.

Guardian Totems.note: Grounding Totem cooldown: utility. 2026-09-27 audit: leveling utility only (kind avoid). PvP (2026-09-27): low, resist: Grounding Totem cooldown 15 -> 13 s (it eats one Polymorph, Fear or nuke); Stoneskin/Windwall +20% is a few points per hit. Grounding itself is baseline.

Improved Ghost Wolf.note: -1s/rank Ghost Wolf cast: travel while leveling. PvP (2026-09-27): medium, move: Ghost Wolf cast 3 -> 1 s (outdoors only): +40% speed usable mid-fight to leave melee or chase. Enhancement staple, out of reach for 30/0/21. Does not remove snares.

Improved Reincarnation.note: Shorter self-res cooldown. PvP (2026-09-27): low, defensive: Reincarnation every 40 min with +20% health and mana: one more self-res per battleground.

Elemental Fury.note: +100% crit damage bonus on Fire/Frost/Nature damage spells and fire totems (healing crits are unaffected). Raid sim calibration (2026-09-27, wowsims/classic 7779ebb, elemental-dps): removing it costs 17.8% DPS in the simulator (scorer said 17.0% on the same scale); already within tolerance, raid effects split off unchanged (17.3%). Other modes unchanged.

Reverberation.note: PvP (2026-09-27): medium, stun: Shock cooldown 6 -> 5 s: more Earth Shock interrupts and Frost Shocks. Core for shock/Stormstrike hybrids; the 30/0/21 build gives it up for Convection (tier 3 here, tier 2 in Forever).
